mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (ID, password, nickname, email, signup_Date, deleted_date, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{signupDate}, #{deletedDate}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status != 'INACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, password = #{password}, WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
